ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This asynchronous online course section starts June 28 and ends August 20. There will also be two face-to-face classes held at the College of Medicine in Rockford, IL. The site-based classes will be held from 6:00 to 8:50 PM on Monday, June 28th and Thursday, July 22nd. The email address for the instructor is jhelton2@uiuc.edu. The room assignment will be added once it has been confirmed.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $386.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $45.00 per Bill Hour.
